skills.name: exec-remote
skills.description: Executes Python scripts, tests, or benchmarks on a provisioned remote cluster (GPU or TPU) using SkyPilot. Entry point skill — delegates to deploy-cluster and apply-resource as needed.

skills.name: deploy-cluster

skills.name: apply-resource
